facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold pieces for the barrow treasure (three-quarters price), payable only once the caravans flow again to Brandonsford.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note was used to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_62); unclear whether the party still holds it or pledged it away.

facts.text: The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note in exchange for their joining the party; the exact terms are unclear.
